Footer

Configure footer text that appears at the bottom of goods receipts.

Use footers to add terms, conditions, or additional information to goods receipts.

Name

Enter a name to identify this footer template.

Content

Enter the footer text that will appear at the bottom of goods receipts. You can use formatting and multiple lines.

Inactive

Check this box to deactivate this footer. It won't appear in selection lists but existing goods receipts will retain it.
